_rule: Where a vendor lists more than one price for a model and the gateway cannot tell which applies (audio against text input, or a price already announced to rise), the higher price is used. Prices by prompt length use long_context.
_cache_rule: Cache prices are the vendors' own: cache_read for cache hits, cache_write for 5-minute (Anthropic) or 30-minute (OpenAI) writes, cache_write_extended for 1-hour or 12-hour writes. A model without one is charged the input price for those tokens. Cache storage billed by the hour (Gemini explicit caching) is not in a response and is not counted.
